Mia: Quick heads-up — trying to lock down SI co-sell rules ahead of Q3 partner push. Need clarity on account mapping (origins), credit split for marketplace/hw referrals, and who maintains the mapping table. Can we align?

Jordan: Do we want SI-origin to default to SI owner through demo stage, or switch to field when field engages? Example: SI spins up demo, field engages for procurement.

Lee: Short answer: if the SI created the lead/opportunity and Origin=SI, SI retains primary ownership until Opportunity Stage >= Proposal unless field explicitly claims with SFDC `Claim Reason`. This avoids flip-flops.

Sara: we can codify with a trigger + ownership matrix. Minimal matrix:
```
Origin | Field Engage Window | Owner Default | Split %
SI     | <30d               | SI            | 70/30 (SI/Field)
SI     | >=30d              | Field         | 50/50
Field  | any                | Field         | 100/0
Marketplace| referral        | Field         | 60/40
```

Mia: Nice. Two follow-ups — (1) who updates the matrix when partners or regions change? (2) how do we handle joint announcements/press?

Jordan: RevOps owns the mapping table but Partnerships owns partner-specific splits. For announcements: partnerships + comms coordinate a joint timeline; marketing runs the embargo.

Lee: For SI engagements, propose we add `SI Advocate` field on opportunity record so we don't lose context. Also add post-demo checkpoint (48h) to confirm ownership.

Sara: I'll open an automation ticket to enforce ownership rules and a scheduled job to flag conflicts. Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partnerships/pages/si-co-sell-protocol

Mia: Action items:
- Jordan add mapping/claims workflow to SFDC by Fri (J)
- Lee add SI Advocate field + post-demo checkbox (L)
- Sara create automation ticket + conflict dashboard (S)
- Mia draft partner announcement checklist for joint go-lives (M)

Jordan: I can take the SFDC piece. Will PR mapping table and ping ops. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Reminder — weekly partnership sync in 2h (agenda: mapping review, marketplace splits).

Mia: thanks all. Let's review updates in next sync; ping here if blockers.
